  53def yaw_from_quaternion(q):
  54    """
  55    Convert a quaternion orientation into a yaw angle.
  56
  57    Args:
  58        q: Quaternion representing the robot orientation.
  59
  60    Returns:
  61        float: Yaw angle in radians.
  62    """
  63
  64    siny_cosp = 2.0 * (q.w * q.z + q.x * q.y)
  65    cosy_cosp = 1.0 - 2.0 * (q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z)
  66    return math.atan2(siny_cosp, cosy_cosp)

  69class ValueCard(QFrame):

  74    def __init__(self, title, value="--", parent=None):

 105class BoolCard(ValueCard):
 106    """
 107    Card widget for displaying boolean states.
 108    """
 109    def __init__(self, title, true_text="AKTIV", false_text="INAKTIV", invert_good=False):
 110        """
 111        Initialize a boolean status card.
 112        """
 113
 114        super().__init__(title)
 115        self.true_text = true_text
 116        self.false_text = false_text
 117        self.invert_good = invert_good
 118        self.set_state(None)
 119
 120    def set_state(self, state):
 121        """
 122        Update the displayed boolean state.
 123
 124        Args:
 125            state: Current boolean state.
 126        """
 127
 128        if state is None:
 129            self.value.setText("--")
 130            self.setStyleSheet("QFrame#card { background: #566573; border-radius: 10px; }")
 131            return
 132
 133        good = (not state) if self.invert_good else bool(state)
 134        color = GREEN if good else RED
 135        self.value.setText(self.true_text if state else self.false_text)
 136        self.setStyleSheet(
 137            f"QFrame#card {{ background: {color}; border-radius: 10px; }}"
 138            "QLabel { color: white; background: transparent; }"
 139        )

 161class RosWorker(QObject):
 162    """
 163    Background worker executing the ROS 2 event loop.
 164    """
 165    data_changed = pyqtSignal(dict)
 166    ros_error = pyqtSignal(str)
 167    finished = pyqtSignal()
 168
 169    def __init__(self):
 170        """
 171        Initialize the ROS worker.
 172        """
 173        super().__init__()
 174        self.running = True
 175        self.node = None
 176        self.executor = None
 177
 178    def run(self):
 179        """
 180        Start the ROS 2 executor and process incoming messages.
 181        """
 182        try:
 183            rclpy.init(args=None)
 184            self.node = MonitorNode(self.data_changed)
 185            self.executor = SingleThreadedExecutor()
 186            self.executor.add_node(self.node)
 187
 188            while self.running and rclpy.ok():
 189                self.executor.spin_once(timeout_sec=0.05)
 190
 191        except Exception as exc:
 192            self.ros_error.emit(str(exc))
 193        finally:
 194            if self.executor and self.node:
 195                self.executor.remove_node(self.node)
 196            if self.node:
 197                self.node.destroy_node()
 198            if rclpy.ok():
 199                rclpy.shutdown()
 200            self.finished.emit()
 201
 202    def stop(self):
 203        """
 204        Request the worker thread to terminate.
 205        """
 206        self.running = False
 207

 209class MonitorNode(Node):
 210    """
 211    ROS 2 node providing monitoring data for the graphical interface.
 212    """
 213    def __init__(self, signal):
 214        """
 215        Initialize all ROS subscriptions and timers.
 216        """
 217        super().__init__("mensabot_gui_monitor")
 218        self.signal = signal
 219        self.last_seen = {}
 220
 221        self.create_subscription(Odometry, "/odom", self.odom_cb, 10)
 222        self.create_subscription(Twist, "/cmd_vel_smoothed", lambda m: self.twist_cb("cmd_vel", m), 10)
 223        self.create_subscription(Twist, "/safety/cmd_vel", lambda m: self.twist_cb("safety_cmd", m), 10)
 224        self.create_subscription(
 225            TwistStamped,
 226            "/mensabot_base_controller/cmd_vel_out",
 227            lambda m: self.twist_cb("controller_cmd", m.twist),
 228            10,
 229        )
 230
 231        self.create_subscription(Bool, "/safety/manual_override", lambda m: self.bool_cb("manual_override", m), 10)
 232        self.create_subscription(Bool, "/safety/estop", lambda m: self.bool_cb("estop", m), 10)
 233        self.create_subscription(Bool, "/hardware/connected", lambda m: self.bool_cb("hardware_connected", m), 10)
 234        self.create_subscription(String, "/safety/field_state", self.field_cb, 10)
 235        self.create_subscription(SpeedLimit, "/speed_limit", self.speed_limit_cb, 10)
 236
 237        self.create_subscription(
 238            OutputPaths, "/lidars/front/output_paths",
 239            lambda m: self.scanner_cb("front", m), 10
 240        )
 241        self.create_subscription(
 242            OutputPaths, "/lidars/rear/output_paths",
 243            lambda m: self.scanner_cb("rear", m), 10
 244        )
 245
 246        self.create_subscription(GoalStatusArray, "/navigate_to_pose/_action/status", self.goal_cb, 10)
 247        self.create_subscription(Imu, "/imu/data", self.imu_cb, 10)
 248
 249        self.create_timer(0.25, self.watchdog_cb)
 250
 251    def mark(self, topic_key):
 252        """
 253        Update the timestamp of the latest received message.
 254
 255        Args:
 256            topic_key: Identifier of the monitored topic.
 257        """
 258        self.last_seen[topic_key] = time.monotonic()
 259
 260    def emit(self, **kwargs):
 261        """
 262        Forward updated monitoring data to the graphical interface.
 263        """
 264        self.signal.emit(kwargs)
 265
 266    def bool_cb(self, key, msg):
 267        """
 268        Process incoming boolean messages.
 269        """
 270        self.mark(key)
 271        self.emit(**{key: bool(msg.data)})
 272
 273    def twist_cb(self, key, msg):
 274        """
 275        Process incoming velocity commands.
 276        """
 277        self.mark(key)
 278        self.emit(**{
 279            key: {
 280                "linear": float(msg.linear.x),
 281                "angular": float(msg.angular.z),
 282            }
 283        })
 284
 285    def odom_cb(self, msg):
 286        """
 287        Process incoming odometry messages.
 288        """
 289        self.mark("odom")
 290        q = msg.pose.pose.orientation
 291        self.emit(odom={
 292            "x": float(msg.pose.pose.position.x),
 293            "y": float(msg.pose.pose.position.y),
 294            "yaw": math.degrees(yaw_from_quaternion(q)),
 295            "linear": float(msg.twist.twist.linear.x),
 296            "angular": float(msg.twist.twist.angular.z),
 297        })
 298
 299    def field_cb(self, msg):
 300        """
 301        Process the current LiDAR monitoring state.
 302        """
 303        self.mark("field_state")
 304        self.emit(field_state=msg.data)
 305
 306    def speed_limit_cb(self, msg):
 307        """
 308        Process speed limit updates.
 309        """
 310        self.mark("speed_limit")
 311        self.emit(speed_limit=float(msg.speed_limit))
 312
 313    def scanner_cb(self, side, msg):
 314        """
 315        Process LiDAR safety scanner status messages.
 316        """
 317        self.mark(f"{side}_scanner")
 318        protective_safe = len(msg.status) > 0 and bool(msg.status[0])
 319        warning_safe = len(msg.status) > 1 and bool(msg.status[1])
 320        self.emit(**{
 321            f"{side}_scanner": {
 322                "protective_safe": protective_safe,
 323                "warning_safe": warning_safe,
 324                "monitoring_case": int(msg.active_monitoring_case),
 325            }
 326        })
 327
 328    def goal_cb(self, msg):
 329        """
 330        Process navigation goal status updates.
 331        """
 332        self.mark("goal_status")
 333        if not msg.status_list:
 334            self.emit(goal_state=("IDLE","#566573")); return
 335        s=msg.status_list[-1].status
 336        m={1:("GOAL ACCEPTED","#5dade2"),2:("DRIVING TO GOAL","#2874a6"),3:("GOAL CANCELING","#d68910"),4:("GOAL SUCCEEDED","#1f8f4e"),5:("GOAL CANCELED","#d68910"),6:("GOAL ABORTED","#c0392b")}
 337        self.emit(goal_state=m.get(s,("UNKNOWN","#566573")))
 338
 339    def imu_cb(self, msg):
 340        """
 341        Process IMU measurements.
 342        """
 343        self.mark("imu")
 344        yaw = math.degrees(yaw_from_quaternion(msg.orientation))
 345        self.emit(imu={
 346            "yaw": yaw,
 347            "yaw_rate": float(msg.angular_velocity.z),
 348        })
 349
 350    def watchdog_cb(self):
 351        """
 352        Monitor message reception times for all subscribed topics.
 353        """
 354        now = time.monotonic()
 355        ages = {}
 356        keys = [
 357            "odom", "cmd_vel", "safety_cmd", "controller_cmd",
 358            "manual_override", "estop", "hardware_connected",
 359            "field_state", "speed_limit", "front_scanner",
 360            "rear_scanner", "imu"
 361        ]
 362        for key in keys:
 363            ages[key] = None if key not in self.last_seen else now - self.last_seen[key]
 364        self.emit(topic_ages=ages)
 365

 716    def start_ros(self):
 717        """
 718        Start the background ROS worker thread.
 719        """
 720        self.ros_thread = QThread(self)
 721        self.ros_worker = RosWorker()
 722        self.ros_worker.moveToThread(self.ros_thread)
 723        self.ros_thread.started.connect(self.ros_worker.run)
 724        self.ros_worker.data_changed.connect(self.on_data)
 725        self.ros_worker.ros_error.connect(self.on_ros_error)
 726        self.ros_worker.finished.connect(self.ros_thread.quit)
 727        self.ros_thread.start()
 728
 729    def on_ros_error(self, text):
 730        """
 731        Display ROS communication errors.
 732        """
 733        self.overall_state.set_state("ROS FEHLER", RED)
 734        self.statusBar().showMessage(text)

 736    def on_data(self, update):
 737        """
 738        Update the graphical interface with newly received monitoring data.
 739        """
 740        self.data.update(update)
 741
 742        if "hardware_connected" in update:
 743            self.hardware.set_state(update["hardware_connected"])
 744
 745        if "goal_state" in update:
 746            st,col=update["goal_state"]
 747            self.goal_state.set_state(st,col)
 748
 749        if "manual_override" in update:
 750            self.manual_override.set_state(update["manual_override"])
 751
 752        if "estop" in update:
 753            self.estop.set_state(update["estop"])
 754
 755        if "speed_limit" in update:
 756            self.speed_limit.set_value(f'{update["speed_limit"]:.0f} %')
 757
 758        if "field_state" in update:
 759            state = update["field_state"]
 760            color = ORANGE if state == "MANUAL_OVERRIDE" else BLUE
 761            self.field.set_state(state, color)
 762
 763        if "odom" in update:
 764            o = update["odom"]
 765            self.pose.set_value(f'x: {o["x"]:.2f} m\ny: {o["y"]:.2f} m\nyaw: {o["yaw"]:.1f} °')
 766            self.odom_card.set_value(f'v: {o["linear"]:+.3f} m/s\nω: {o["angular"]:+.3f} rad/s')
 767
 768        if "imu" in update:
 769            i = update["imu"]
 770            self.imu.set_value(f'Yaw: {i["yaw"]:.1f} °\nYaw Rate: {i["yaw_rate"]:+.3f} rad/s')
 771
 772        if "cmd_vel" in update:
 773            self.set_twist_card(self.cmd_card, update["cmd_vel"])
 774        if "safety_cmd" in update:
 775            self.set_twist_card(self.safety_cmd_card, update["safety_cmd"])
 776        if "controller_cmd" in update:
 777            self.set_twist_card(self.controller_cmd_card, update["controller_cmd"])
 778
 779        if "front_scanner" in update:
 780            s = update["front_scanner"]
 781            self.front_warning.set_state(s["warning_safe"])
 782            self.front_protect.set_state(s["protective_safe"])
 783
 784        if "rear_scanner" in update:
 785            s = update["rear_scanner"]
 786            self.rear_warning.set_state(s["warning_safe"])
 787            self.rear_protect.set_state(s["protective_safe"])
 788
 789        if "topic_ages" in update:
 790            self.update_watchdog(update["topic_ages"])
 791
 792        self.update_motion_state()
 793        self.update_field_match()
 794        self.update_overall_state()
 795
 796    def set_twist_card(self, card, value):
 797        """
 798        Update a velocity display card.
 799        """
 800        card.set_value(f'v: {value["linear"]:+.3f} m/s\nω: {value["angular"]:+.3f} rad/s')

 802    def derive_motion(self):
 803        """
 804        Determine the current robot motion from controller commands.
 805
 806        Returns:
 807            str: Current motion state.
 808        """
 809        v = self.data.get("controller_cmd", {}).get("linear", 0.0)
 810        w = self.data.get("controller_cmd", {}).get("angular", 0.0)
 811        lin_th = 0.02
 812        ang_th = 0.05
 813
 814        if abs(v) < lin_th and abs(w) < ang_th:
 815            return "STILLSTAND"
 816        if v > lin_th and abs(w) < ang_th:
 817            return "VORWÄRTS"
 818        if v < -lin_th and abs(w) < ang_th:
 819            return "RÜCKWÄRTS"
 820        if abs(v) < lin_th and w > ang_th:
 821            return "DREHUNG LINKS"
 822        if abs(v) < lin_th and w < -ang_th:
 823            return "DREHUNG RECHTS"
 824        return "KURVENFAHRT VORWÄRTS" if v > 0 else "KURVENFAHRT RÜCKWÄRTS"
 825
 826    def update_motion_state(self):
 827        """
 828        Update the displayed robot motion state.
 829        """
 830        self.motion.set_state(self.derive_motion(), BLUE)
 831
 832    def update_field_match(self):
 833        """
 834        Check whether the selected LiDAR field matches the robot motion.
 835        """
 836        field = self.data.get("field_state")
 837        if field is None:
 838            self.field_match.set_state(None)
 839            return
 840
 841        if self.data.get("manual_override", False):
 842            self.field_match.set_state(True)
 843            return
 844
 845        motion = self.derive_motion()
 846        expected = {
 847            "STILLSTAND": "STOP",
 848            "VORWÄRTS": "FORWARD",
 849            "RÜCKWÄRTS": "BACKWARD",
 850            "DREHUNG LINKS": "ROTATE_LEFT",
 851            "DREHUNG RECHTS": "ROTATE_RIGHT",
 852            "KURVENFAHRT VORWÄRTS": "FORWARD",
 853            "KURVENFAHRT RÜCKWÄRTS": "BACKWARD",
 854        }.get(motion)
 855
 856        self.field_match.set_state(field == expected)
 857
 858    def update_overall_state(self):
 859        """
 860        Determine and display the overall system status.
 861        """
 862        if self.data.get("estop", False):
 863            self.overall_state.set_state("E-STOP AKTIV", RED)
 864        elif self.data.get("hardware_connected") is False:
 865            self.overall_state.set_state("HARDWARE GETRENNT", RED)
 866        elif self.data.get("manual_override", False):
 867            self.overall_state.set_state("MANUAL OVERRIDE", ORANGE)
 868        elif self.any_protective_triggered():
 869            self.overall_state.set_state("SCHUTZFELD AKTIV", RED)
 870        elif self.any_warning_triggered():
 871            self.overall_state.set_state("WARNFELD AKTIV", ORANGE)
 872        else:
 873            self.overall_state.set_state("BETRIEBSBEREIT", GREEN)
 874
 875    def any_protective_triggered(self):
 876        """
 877        Check whether any protective field is active.
 878
 879        Returns:
 880            bool: True if a protective field is active.
 881        """
 882        for side in ("front_scanner", "rear_scanner"):
 883            if side in self.data and not self.data[side]["protective_safe"]:
 884                return True
 885        return False
 886
 887    def any_warning_triggered(self):
 888        """
 889        Check whether any warning field is active.
 890
 891        Returns:
 892            bool: True if a warning field is active.
 893        """
 894        for side in ("front_scanner", "rear_scanner"):
 895            if side in self.data and not self.data[side]["warning_safe"]:
 896                return True
 897        return False

 899    def update_watchdog(self, ages):
 900        """
 901        Update the topic watchdog indicators.
 902        """
 903        for key, age in ages.items():
 904            if key not in self.watchdog_labels:
 905                continue
 906
 907            label = self.watchdog_labels[key]
 908            if age is None:
 909                text = "NO DATA"
 910                color = RED
 911            elif age < 1.0:
 912                text = f"{age:.2f} s"
 913                color = GREEN
 914            elif age < 2.0:
 915                text = f"{age:.2f} s"
 916                color = ORANGE
 917            else:
 918                text = f"{age:.2f} s TIMEOUT"
 919                color = RED
 920
 921            topic = label.text().split(":")[0]
 922            label.setText(f"{topic}: {text}")
 923            label.setStyleSheet(
 924                f"background: {color}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; color: white;"
 925            )
 926
 927        front_age = ages.get("front_scanner")
 928        rear_age = ages.get("rear_scanner")
 929        self.front_data.set_state(front_age is not None and front_age < 1.0)
 930        self.rear_data.set_state(rear_age is not None and rear_age < 1.0)
 931
 932    def update_plots(self):
 933        """
 934        Update the live velocity plots.
 935        """
 936        t = time.monotonic() - self.start_time
 937
 938        cmd = self.data.get("cmd_vel", {"linear": 0.0, "angular": 0.0})
 939        ctrl = self.data.get("controller_cmd", {"linear": 0.0, "angular": 0.0})
 940        odom = self.data.get("odom", {"linear": 0.0, "angular": 0.0})
 941
 942        self.history_t.append(t)
 943        self.history_cmd.append(cmd["linear"])
 944        self.history_ctrl.append(ctrl["linear"])
 945        self.history_odom.append(odom["linear"])
 946
 947        self.history_w_cmd.append(cmd["angular"])
 948        self.history_w_ctrl.append(ctrl["angular"])
 949        self.history_w_odom.append(odom["angular"])
 950
 951        x = list(self.history_t)
 952        self.lin_cmd_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_cmd))
 953        self.lin_ctrl_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_ctrl))
 954        self.lin_odom_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_odom))
 955
 956        self.ang_cmd_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_w_cmd))
 957        self.ang_ctrl_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_w_ctrl))
 958        self.ang_odom_curve.setData(x, list(self.history_w_odom))
 959
 960        # ---------------------------------------------------------
 961        # Auto Follow
 962        # ---------------------------------------------------------
 963
 964        if self.auto_follow and len(x) > 2:
 965
 966            xmax = x[-1]
 967            xmin = max(0.0, xmax - self.time_window)
 968
 969            self.linear_plot.setXRange(xmin, xmax, padding=0)
 970            self.angular_plot.setXRange(xmin, xmax, padding=0)
 971
 972            # Nur Werte innerhalb des sichtbaren Fensters betrachten
 973            visible = [i for i, t in enumerate(x) if t >= xmin]
 974
 975            if visible:
 976
 977                lin_values = (
 978                    [self.history_cmd[i] for i in visible] +
 979                    [self.history_ctrl[i] for i in visible] +
 980                    [self.history_odom[i] for i in visible]
 981                )
 982
 983                ang_values = (
 984                    [self.history_w_cmd[i] for i in visible] +
 985                    [self.history_w_ctrl[i] for i in visible] +
 986                    [self.history_w_odom[i] for i in visible]
 987                )
 988
 989                if lin_values:
 990                    ymin = min(lin_values)
 991                    ymax = max(lin_values)
 992
 993                    if abs(ymax - ymin) < 0.05:
 994                        ymin -= 0.05
 995                        ymax += 0.05
 996
 997                    margin = (ymax - ymin) * 0.10
 998
 999                    self.linear_plot.setYRange(
1000                        ymin - margin,
1001                        ymax + margin,
1002                        padding=0
1003                    )
1004
1005                if ang_values:
1006                    ymin = min(ang_values)
1007                    ymax = max(ang_values)
1008
1009                    if abs(ymax - ymin) < 0.05:
1010                        ymin -= 0.05
1011                        ymax += 0.05
1012
1013                    margin = (ymax - ymin) * 0.10
1014
1015                    self.angular_plot.setYRange(
1016                        ymin - margin,
1017                        ymax + margin,
1018                        padding=0
1019                    )
1020
1021    def toggle_auto_follow(self, checked):
1022        """
1023        Enable or disable automatic plot following.
1024        """
1025        self.auto_follow = checked

1027    def change_time_window(self, text):

1029        Update the displayed plot time window.

1033    def center_plots(self):
1034        """
1035        Re-center the live plots and enable automatic following.
1036        """
1037        self.auto_follow = True
1038        self.auto_follow_checkbox.setChecked(True)
1039
1040        self.linear_plot.enableAutoRange(axis="y")
1041        self.angular_plot.enableAutoRange(axis="y")
1042    
1043    def user_changed_plot(self):
1044        """
1045        Disable automatic following after manual plot interaction.
1046        """
1047        if self.auto_follow:
1048            self.auto_follow = False
1049
1050            self.auto_follow_checkbox.blockSignals(True)
1051            self.auto_follow_checkbox.setChecked(False)
1052            self.auto_follow_checkbox.blockSignals(False)
1053
1054    def closeEvent(self, event):
1055        """
1056        Stop all background components before closing the application.
1057        """
1058        self.plot_timer.stop()
1059        self.ros_worker.stop()
1060        self.ros_thread.quit()
1061        self.ros_thread.wait(3000)
1062        event.accept()

1065def main():
1066    """
1067    Start the Mensabot monitoring application.
1068    """
1069    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
1070    app.setFont(QFont("DejaVu Sans", 10))
1071    pg.setConfigOption("background", DARK)
1072    pg.setConfigOption("foreground", TEXT)
1073
1074    window = MensabotMonitor()
1075    window.show()
1076    sys.exit(app.exec())
